verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe following an agent's progress live, sending a correction mid-task, or queuing the next task, plus pausing for questions/approval — core to takeover/redirect. Cross-platform access is supported via dashboard, CLI/API/SDK, Slack connector, and persistent conversation history across crashes/disconnects lets work resume seamlessly across devices. Community feedback (mobile SSH-tab usage, phone-based Claude Code) corroborates real editor/terminal/browser handoff use. Missing for 10: no first-party hands-on report specifically demonstrating mid-task redirect success/failure, and some community skepticism about UI copy/paste friction slightly limits polish confidence.
